title: Current Bottleneck by Stage
note: Bottleneck analysis from A100 source-level analysis + existing profiling. Backward timing breakdown requires Nsight Compute profiling which was not available.

room_2K.estimated_breakdown: At 270K Gaussians (SH degree 0-1), the forward pass is ~4.1ms. Intersect_sort dominates at ~2.6ms (64%). Raster backward is NOT_MEASURED but estimated at ~10ms based on scaling from the 500-step profiler (which used 1.1M Gaussians with 20.6ms raster backward at room tile16).

bottleneck_#2.note: Estimated from 1.1M G profile scaled down

room_10K.estimated_breakdown: Forward ~4.8ms (intersect_sort ~3.1ms, 64%). Raster backward estimated at ~19ms based on scaling. Total iter ~36ms.

bottleneck_#1.note: Dominant as N grows; per-Gaussian-per-tile gradient computation scales with tile intersections

room_20K.estimated_breakdown: Forward ~4.9ms (intersect_sort ~3.1ms). Raster backward estimated at ~22ms. Total iter ~40ms. Post-densification: densification overhead (add_stats, densify calls) drops to 0.

summary: The dominant per-iteration bottleneck is raster_backward (estimated ~50-55% of iteration time at peak N) for indoor scenes, and intersect_sort (67% of forward) which is ~35-40% of total iteration since backward is longer. For outdoor scenes with huge Gaussian counts, intersect_sort dominates the forward pass even more (67%). The optimizer is a consistent ~15% of iteration time.
